scope: Native bounded Keccak-256 reference and exactly one Boolean Keccak-f[1600] Script round; not an authenticated whole hash or Nova verifier

bitvm_reuse_review.finding: Pinned hash module contains SHA256 and Blake3, no Keccak. The mature u4/u32 XOR/AND gadgets use persistent lookup tables and a different stack layout. This trace instead uses the existing typed Script compiler with tiny Boolean equality/arithmetic predicates; it uses no disabled OP_XOR/OP_AND/OP_INVERT opcodes.

conventions.rounds: 0 through 23; each Script graph implements only the selected round

composition_blocker: Separate per-round programs or identically spelled boundary wire names do not establish a shared authenticated assertion registry. Whole-hash linkage, absorption, padding and squeeze remain required.
